```{r setup}
library(yaml)
library(htmltools)

source("scripts/topic_labels.R")
source("scripts/site_helpers.R")

pubs  <- yaml::read_yaml("data/publications.yaml")
ids   <- pub_ids(pubs)
years <- vapply(pubs, function(p) as.integer(p$year), integer(1))

stats <- tryCatch(
  yaml::read_yaml("data/scholar_stats.yaml"),
  error = function(e) list(total_citations = "--", h_index = "--", i10_index = "--")
)
grants <- tryCatch(yaml::read_yaml("data/grants.yaml"), error = function(e) list())
grant_summary <- tryCatch(
  yaml::read_yaml("data/grants_summary.yaml"),
  error = function(e) list(pass_count = 0, pass_total = 0)
)
funding <- grant_funding(grants, grant_summary)

ord        <- order(years, decreasing = TRUE)
n_recent   <- min(5, length(pubs))
recent     <- pubs[ord][seq_len(n_recent)]
recent_ids <- ids[ord][seq_len(n_recent)]
```

```{r record}
# The research record: one block per paper, stacked by year, colored by
# primary topic. Built straight from publications.yaml, so it grows on its
# own every time the CV sync adds a paper.
topic_order <- topics_in_use(pubs)
primary     <- vapply(pubs, pub_primary_topic, character(1))
year_range  <- seq(min(years), max(years))

cols <- vapply(year_range, function(y) {
  idx <- which(years == y)
  idx <- idx[order(match(primary[idx], topic_order))]
  cells <- vapply(idx, function(i) {
    p <- pubs[[i]]
    label <- topic_label_for(primary[i])
    sprintf('<a class="record-cell" href="research.html#%s" data-topic="%s" data-title="%s" data-meta="%s" aria-label="%s"></a>',
            esc(ids[i]), esc(primary[i]), esc(p$title),
            esc(paste0(p$journal %||% "", ", ", p$year)),
            esc(paste0(p$title, ". ", label, ", ", p$year)))
  }, character(1))
  sprintf('<div class="record-col" role="listitem" aria-label="%d: %d %s"><div class="record-stack">%s</div><div class="record-n" aria-hidden="true">%s</div><div class="record-year">%d</div></div>',
          y, length(idx), if (length(idx) == 1) "article" else "articles",
          paste(cells, collapse = ""),
          if (length(idx) > 0) as.character(length(idx)) else "&nbsp;", y)
}, character(1))

legend <- vapply(topic_order, function(slug) {
  n <- sum(vapply(pubs, function(p) slug %in% pub_topics(p), logical(1)))
  sprintf('<li><a href="research.html#topic=%s" data-topic="%s"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="legend-label">%s</span><span class="legend-n">%d</span></a></li>',
          esc(slug), esc(slug), esc(topic_label_for(slug)), n)
}, character(1))

HTML(sprintf(
'<section class="record-section" aria-labelledby="record-heading">
  <div class="section-head">
    <p class="eyebrow">The record</p>
    <h2 id="record-heading">%d articles, %d to %d</h2>
    <p class="section-lede">Each block is one peer-reviewed article, stacked by year and colored by topic. Select a block to read its plain-language summary, or a topic to see everything in that area.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="record">
    <div class="record-chart" role="list">%s</div>
    <ul class="record-legend" aria-label="Research topics">%s</ul>
  </div>
  <div class="record-tip" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</section>',
  length(pubs), min(years), max(years),
  paste(cols, collapse = ""),
  paste(legend, collapse = "")
))
```

<script>
(function () {
  var record = document.querySelector('.record');
  var tip = document.querySelector('.record-tip');
  if (!record || !tip) return;
  var cells = record.querySelectorAll('.record-cell');

  function show(cell) {
    tip.textContent = '';
    var t = document.createElement('strong'); t.textContent = cell.dataset.title;
    var m = document.createElement('span');   m.textContent = cell.dataset.meta;
    tip.appendChild(t); tip.appendChild(m);
    tip.dataset.topic = cell.dataset.topic;
    tip.classList.add('is-on');
    var r = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
    var w = tip.offsetWidth, pad = 12;
    var x = Math.min(Math.max(r.left + r.width / 2 - w / 2, pad), window.innerWidth - w - pad);
    var y = r.top - tip.offsetHeight - 10;
    if (y < 70) y = r.bottom + 10;
    tip.style.left = x + 'px';
    tip.style.top = y + 'px';
  }
  function hide() { tip.classList.remove('is-on'); }

  cells.forEach(function (c) {
    c.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { show(c); });
    c.addEventListener('focus', function () { show(c); });
    c.addEventListener('mouseleave', hide);
    c.addEventListener('blur', hide);
  });
  window.addEventListener('scroll', hide, { passive: true });

  // Hovering a topic in the legend spotlights its blocks in the chart.
  record.querySelectorAll('.record-legend a').forEach(function (a) {
    function on() {
      cells.forEach(function (c) { c.classList.toggle('is-dim', c.dataset.topic !== a.dataset.topic); });
    }
    function off() {
      cells.forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('is-dim'); });
    }
    a.addEventListener('mouseenter', on); a.addEventListener('focus', on);
    a.addEventListener('mouseleave', off); a.addEventListener('blur', off);
  });
})();
</script>
